findings.summary: Untracked doc-tooling state file with no prior history and no .gitignore entry, left in the working tree

A7's 'previously active item loses active' is inferred from initial scrollspy state rather than an explicit prior click, so the transition is not as tightly pinned as the contract wording implies (test still passes for the right reasons today)
Scrollspy tie-break on equal intersection ratios relies on Map insertion order rather than an explicit rule; benign given section sizing but worth a comment for future maintainers
Prize-line list keyed on prize.amount would collide if a future award had two identical amounts in one list; no current data triggers it
